limits: Codex initial output includes helper self-grading; root later inspected targeted drafts. Helper had already seen rubrics/feedback at final retest, so those drafts are rubric-aware, not blinded.

g1_retest.method: Same root manual inspection, rubric-aware and not blinded; one draft per attempt. Sources re-fed after absence-as-fact discipline edits to the lead instruction file per scenario (entrepreneur, cisa-audit, test-strategy, database-reviewer).

cases.assessment: Dedicated unknowns section; states "The brief does not state whether a priced offer or payment attempt was made" instead of asserting the event either way; CAC/runway/LTV left uncomputable; payment fees flagged as unstated reducers.
Declines certification; "Control frequency: unknown — not 'no defined frequency'"; unexamined screenshots not presumed; every uncited attribute routed to an evidence request.

Attempt 2. Boundary-by-boundary analysis; acknowledged-then-thrown write treated as unresolved with reconciliation before any replay; uninspected suites handled as verification questions; coverage gap explicitly not the incident cause.

Reasons from stated premises (owner role, RLS enabled-not-forced) via documented owner-bypass semantics; grants/memberships/policies "not shown in the excerpt — confirm before relying on either their presence or absence"; missing plan recorded under limitations, not findings.

attempt1_over_correction.outcome: G1 held but core Q1-Q3 were absent: the draft answered epistemically and skipped the engineering substance. The first test-strategy wording ("remove any stated content ... not actually read") suppressed conditional reasoning from the brief's own premises; rewritten to license given premises while banning additions, then attempt 2 passed all criteria.

limits: Single graded draft per attempt from one model family; the same grader wrote the discipline edits, so this is rubric-aware verification, not blinded or statistically representative.
Wording was iterated against these four scenarios; generalization beyond them is untested — this is not a universal advice pass.
